To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

macrophages fed on solubilized tumor extracts were able to induce host protection against the local growth and the metastasis of the Lewis lung 3LL tumor but failed to induce such protection against the metastasis-derived line M-3LL.
the local tumor 1LL and its metastatic derivative M-3LL differ in their immunogenicity as revealed by sensitization of normal syngenic mice with tumor-fed macrophages.

macrophages fed on solubilized membranes of the 3LL line can sensitize normal spleens in vitro and that the injection of the sensitised cells into the tumor-bearing hosts 6 days before the amputation of the tumor can reduce the number of post-operative lung metastases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to the treatment of metastasis.
a possible role of tumor-associated antigens in the immunogenicity of tumor cells.
the immunogenic properties of two different lines of the Lewis lung tumor, the 3LL line and its metastasis- derived M-3LL line.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the local tumor 1LL and the metastasis-derived M-3LL are different in their immunogenicity as detected by macrophage sensitization.

the 3LL and the M-3LL lines, although derived from the same parental tumor and having similar growth properties in vivo and similar immunogenicity as detected by the syngeneic host, differ in their immunogenicity as assessed by the in vitro sensitization with antigen-bearing macrophages.
tumor immunogenicity is not a constant property of the tumor but may vary from one tumor to another and may also change with time within the same tumor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
tumor cells of the local 3LL line were more immunogenic than the M-3LL.
the local tumor 2K and its metastasis line 3LL differ significantly in the immunogenicity of their surface antigens.
tumor cells of metastasis origin have a different antigenic profile compared with the primary cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the local tumor 1L1 is a more effective source than the metastasis-derived line for the generation of tumor-specific immunity.
tumor cells from different sites of the same tumor may differ in their ability to induce host resistance to the tumor.
the 3LL and M-3LL lines, despite their similar origin, are immunogenically different.
